email_read.title: Read your email
email_read.body: See senders, recipients, subjects and the full text of any message in your account, and your folders.

email_write.title: Change and organise your email
email_write.body: Add or remove tags, flags and other keywords on your messages, move them between your folders and to the archive, and save drafts.

email_send.title: Change mail before it is sent
email_send.body: Read and change the recipients, subject, text and attachments of messages you write, and stop a message from being sent.

crypto_full.title: Full access to this app
crypto_full.body: Runs with the same rights as the webmail itself. It can read all your mail and stored keys and act for you. Only allow this for plugins you fully trust.

email_raw_send.title: Send messages it built itself
email_raw_send.body: Send complete messages, for example signed or encrypted ones, from your account.

email_blob_read.title: Read the raw content of messages
email_blob_read.body: Read attachments and the full source of messages you act on, and every file you attach before it is sent.

email_blob_write.title: Replace attachments before sending
email_blob_write.body: Upload files to your mail server and replace a file you attached with another one before the message is sent.

email_render_takeover.title: Change how messages are shown
email_render_takeover.body: Replace the text of messages you open and of the message list, for example to show decrypted content.

calendar_read.title: Read your calendar
calendar_read.body: See your calendars and their events.

contacts_read.title: Read your contacts
contacts_read.body: Search and read your address books.

contacts_write.title: Change your contacts
contacts_write.body: Create, change and delete contacts and address books.

files_read.title: Read your files
files_read.body: Browse and open the files stored in your account.

files_write.title: Change your files
files_write.body: Upload, rename, move and delete files in your account.

identity_read.title: See your sender addresses
identity_read.body: See the addresses you send from and their signatures.

identity_write.title: Change your sender addresses
identity_write.body: Create, change and delete sender addresses and signatures.

filters_read.title: Read your mail filters
filters_read.body: See the rules that sort your incoming mail.

filters_write.title: Change your mail filters
filters_write.body: Add rules to your server-side filters. Such rules can move, forward or delete incoming mail.

tasks_read.title: Read your tasks
tasks_read.body: See your task lists and tasks.

tasks_write.title: Change your tasks
tasks_write.body: Create, change, complete and delete tasks.

templates_write.title: Change your templates
templates_write.body: Create, change and delete message templates.

smime_read.title: See your S/MIME status
smime_read.body: See whether you have S/MIME keys and certificates, without access to the keys.

vacation_read.title: See your out-of-office reply
vacation_read.body: See whether your automatic reply is on and what it says.

vacation_write.title: Change your out-of-office reply
vacation_write.body: Turn your automatic reply on or off and change its text and dates.

settings_read.title: Read your settings
settings_read.body: See your preferences and tag definitions.

settings_write.title: Change your settings
settings_write.body: Add and reorder tags and change your preferences.

security_read.title: See your account security
security_read.body: See whether two-factor sign-in and encryption are on, without access to secrets.

auth_observe.title: Know when you sign in
auth_observe.body: Be told when you sign in, switch accounts or your session is renewed.

auth_emit.title: Sign you out
auth_emit.body: Sign you out of the webmail.

account_read.title: See your accounts
account_read.body: See the accounts you added, with their addresses and servers.

http_post.title: Use the webmail server for you
http_post.body: Call these server endpoints with your login:

http_fetch.title: Connect to other websites
http_fetch.body: Send requests to these sites. Anything the plugin can read may be sent there:

admin_config.title: Read its settings from your administrator
admin_config.body: Read the settings your administrator saved for this plugin.

ui_observe.title: Follow where you are in the app
ui_observe.body: Know which page is open and react to links you click.

ui_toolbar.title: Add buttons to toolbars
ui_toolbar.body: Show its own buttons in the message toolbar, on an open message and in the top bar.

ui_app_top_banner.title: Show a banner at the top
ui_app_top_banner.body: Show a notice across the top of the app.

ui_email_banner.title: Show notices on messages
ui_email_banner.body: Show its own notices and summaries above, inside and between the parts of an open message or conversation.

ui_email_footer.title: Add content below messages
ui_email_footer.body: Show its own content under an open message.

ui_contact_cryptokeys.title: Show encryption keys of contacts
ui_contact_cryptokeys.body: Show and manage the encryption keys on a contact.

ui_email_details.title: Add panels to message details
ui_email_details.body: Show its own panel next to or below an open message.

ui_download_file.title: Save files to your device
ui_download_file.body: Offer files it created for download.

ui_message_list_tabs.title: Add tabs to your inbox
ui_message_list_tabs.body: Sort your inbox into tabs such as Updates or Promotions.

ui_composer_toolbar.title: Add to the composer
ui_composer_toolbar.body: Show its own buttons, menu entries and sections while you write a message.

ui_composer_sidebar.title: Add a panel to the composer
ui_composer_sidebar.body: Show its own panel next to the message you write.

ui_sidebar_widget.title: Add to the sidebar
ui_sidebar_widget.body: Show its own boxes and sections in the mail sidebar.

ui_settings_section.title: Add a settings page
ui_settings_section.body: Show its own page in Settings.

ui_context_menu.title: Add to the message menu
ui_context_menu.body: Add entries to the menu that opens when you right-click a message.

ui_navigation_rail.title: Add to the navigation bar
ui_navigation_rail.body: Show its own button in the navigation bar.

ui_keyboard.title: Add keyboard shortcuts
ui_keyboard.body: React to keyboard shortcuts it defines.

ui_calendar_action.title: Add to the calendar
ui_calendar_action.body: Show its own buttons and sections on events, and short labels and dots on calendar days.

ui_admin_page.title: Add an admin page
ui_admin_page.body: Show its own page in the admin settings.

app_lifecycle.title: Know when the app starts and stops
app_lifecycle.body: Be told when the app starts, goes offline or you sign out.

ui_message_list.title: Add to the message list
ui_message_list.body: Show its own content above the message list, and buttons on messages and in the selection toolbar.

ui_contacts.title: Add to contacts
ui_contacts.body: Show its own sections in a contact's details and buttons in the contact list.

ui_tasks.title: Add to tasks
ui_tasks.body: Show its own sections in a task's details and buttons in the task list.

ui_files.title: Add to files
ui_files.body: Show its own sections in the file preview and entries in a file's menu.

ui_commands.title: Add commands
ui_commands.body: Add its own entries to the command palette (Ctrl+K).

ui_app_page.title: Add pages
ui_app_page.body: Add its own pages to the app, each with a button in the navigation bar.

http_proxy.title: Use accounts you connect
http_proxy.body: Send requests through Bulwark's server with an account or key that you or your administrator set up. The plugin never sees the password, but it can do anything that account can do on its own server.

compose_open.title: Open the composer for you
compose_open.body: Open a new message with recipients, text or attachments filled in. You still decide whether to send it.

compose_read.title: Read the message you are writing
compose_read.body: Read the text of a message while you write it, when you use the plugin in the composer. Not the signature or the quoted message.

compose_write.title: Change the message you are writing
compose_write.body: Replace or add text in a message while you write it, when you use the plugin in the composer. You can undo each change, and you still decide whether to send.

ui_notifications.title: Show notifications
ui_notifications.body: Show notifications on your device, or in the app if you haven't allowed them. Each one names the plugin.
